title: Tangle structure trees
summary: We introduce a comprehensive data structure, tangle structure trees, which simultaneously displays all the $\mathcal{F}$-tangles of an abstract separation system for very general obstruction sets $\mathcal{F}$. It simultaneously also displays certificates $σ\in\mathcal{F}$ for any non-existence of such tangles, or for the non-extendability of low-order tangles to higher-order ones. Our theorem can be applied to produce the structures of the classical tree-of-tangles and tangle-tree duality theorems, both for graph tangles and for their known generalizations to more general separation…
